questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who composed the poem 'My Grandmother's House'?
questions.explanation: 'My Grandmother's House' prasiddh Indo-Anglian kavyitri Kamala Das dwara rachi gayi aatmkathatmak kavita hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who wrote 'The Old Playhouse and Other Poems'?
questions.explanation: 'The Old Playhouse and Other Poems' (1973) Kamala Das ka prasiddh kavya-sangrah hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is the author of 'Summer in Kolkata'?
questions.explanation: 'Summer in Kolkata' (1963) Kamala Das ki mahatvapurna angrezi rachna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Snakes were seen moving among .......... in my grandmother's house.
questions.explanation: Dadi ki mrityu ke baad sunsan ghar mein kitabon ke beech saamp ghoomte huye dekhe gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Kamala Das remembers the happy days spent in the sweet company of her ..........
questions.explanation: Kavyitri apne bachpan ke befikra din apni dadi maa (grandmother) ke sneh aur aashirwad mein bitane ko yaad karti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poetess in 'My Grandmother's House' begs for love at .......... doors.
questions.explanation: Vaivahik jeevan mein prem na milne par kavyitri ajanabiyon ke darwazon par prem ki bheekh maangti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... lived with her grandmother during her childhood.
questions.explanation: Kamala Das apne bachpan ke shuruaati saalon mein apni dadi maa ke ghar par unke sath rehti theen.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Among books, I was then too young' is taken from which poem?
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti 'My Grandmother's House' kavita se li gayi hai jahan weh kitabein na padh paane ka zikr karti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poetess's blood turned cold like the ..........
questions.explanation: Kitabon ke beech saamp dekhkar aur dadi ke bichhadne ke dar se unka khoon chaand (moon) ki tarah thanda pad gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Darkness to bring it here to lie' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti 'My Grandmother's House' se hai jisme weh dadi ke ghar ke andhere ko apne kamre mein laana chahti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poetess wanted to keep the memories of darkness behind her bedroom door like a brooding ..........
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'Behind my bedroom's door like a brooding Dog' jo ek wafadar aur chintan-magn kutte ki tarah baithne ka prateek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'There is a house now far away where once I received love' is from the poem ..........

options.C: Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast

questions.explanation: Yeh kavita 'My Grandmother's House' ki pehli aur sabse prasiddh shuruaati pankti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the concluding lines of the poem, the poetess is begging for ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita ke ant mein kavyitri ajanabiyon ke darwaze par sachhe prem (love) ki bheekh maang rahi hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Kamala Das is an eminent .......... poetess.
questions.explanation: Kamala Das bhartiya-angrezi saahitya ki prasiddh Indo-Anglian kavyitri hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'My way and beg now at strangers' doors' is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti 'My Grandmother's House' se li gayi hai jahan weh apne aatmsamman aur prem ki khoj ka varnan karti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Kamala Das has earned a respectable place in both English and .......... literature.
questions.explanation: Unhone angrezi aur malayalam dono bhashaon ke saahitya mein atyant sammanit sthan prapt kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Kamala Das born?
questions.explanation: Kamala Das ka janam 31 March 1934 ko Punnayurkulam, Kerala mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did Kamala Das pass away?
questions.explanation: Kamala Das ka nidhan 31 May 2009 ko Pune ke ek aspatal mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Kamala Das's autobiography published that created quite a stir?
questions.explanation: Unki aatmkatha 'My Story' saal 1976 mein prakashit hui thi jisne sahityik jagat mein hulchul macha di thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Kamala Das shortlisted for the Nobel Prize for Literature?
questions.explanation: Saal 1984 mein unhe saahitya ke Nobel Prize ke liye shortlist kiya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What happened to the grandmother's house immediately after that woman died?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein likha hai: 'That woman died, The house withdrew into silence'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The figure of speech used in 'my blood turned cold like the moon' is a/an ..........
questions.explanation: 'Like' shabd ka prayog karke khoon ki thandak ki tulna chaand se ki gayi hai, atah yeh Simile (upma alankar) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The phrase 'blind eyes of windows' is an example of which literary device?
questions.explanation: Khidkiyon par dhool jami hone ke kaaran unhe 'andhi aankhein' kehkar manvikaran (Personification) kiya gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How is the air inside the deserted house described by the poetess?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein sunsan ghar ke bheetar ki hawa ko 'frozen air' (jami hui thandi hawa) kaha gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poetess wish to pick and bring back from the house?
questions.explanation: Weh apni dadi ke ghar ki yaadon aur shanti ko 'an armful of darkness' ke roop mein samet kar laana chahti hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whom is the poetess addressing with the word 'darling' in the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavyitri apne vartaman jeevansathi (husband) ko sambodhit karte huye kehti hain: 'you cannot believe, darling'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did the poetess feel during her stay at her grandmother's house?
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'that I lived in such a house and Was proud, and loved'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the metaphor 'in small change' signify in the poem?

options.B: Love received in tiny bits, gestures, or fragments

questions.explanation: 'Small change' chhote sikko ki tarah thoda sa prem ya aatmiyata milne ki aasha ko darshata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which volume of verse was published by Kamala Das in 1967?
questions.explanation: 'The Descendants' ka prakashan saal 1967 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which poetry collection by Kamala Das appeared in 2001?
questions.explanation: 'Yes, Allah' saal 2001 mein aayi unki pramukh rachna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the primary genre and theme of Kamala Das's poetry?

options.B: Autobiographical expression of a lonely heart seeking love

questions.explanation: Unki kavita mukhya roop se aatmkathatmak hai jo akele dil ki prem ki tadap ko vyakt karti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Under which famous pen name did Kamala Das write in Malayalam literature?
questions.explanation: Malayalam saahitya mein Kamala Das 'Madhavikutty' ke naam se lekh aur kahaniyan likhti theen.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why was the speaker unable to read the books in her grandmother's house?

options.A: Because the books were locked in a trunk
options.B: Because she was then too young to read
options.C: Because she did not like reading

questions.explanation: Kavita mein likha hai: 'I was then too young To read'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the intrusion of snakes among books primarily symbolize?

options.B: Decay, loneliness, fear, and death invading innocent memories

questions.explanation: Kitabon ke beech saanpo ka aana vidhwans, dar aur parivar ke bikharne ka prateek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the dominant tone of the poem 'My Grandmother's House'?
questions.explanation: Kavita ka mukhya swar dadi ke ghar ki madhur yaadon aur akelepan ke dard (nostalgic and melancholy) se bhara hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What contrast is explored between the speaker's childhood and her married adulthood?

options.B: Unconditional love and security vs emotional isolation and lovelessness

questions.explanation: Bachpan mein mila nishswarth prem aur badappan mein mila akelapan is kavita ka mool virodhabhas hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which poetic work was published by Kamala Das in 1964?
questions.explanation: 'Sirens' ka prakashan saal 1964 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'peer' in 'to peer through blind eyes of windows'?
questions.explanation: 'Peer' ka arth dhyaan se ya jhaank kar dekhna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the expression 'lost my way' signify in the poem?

options.B: Emotional disorientation and deprivation of true affection

questions.explanation: 'Lost my way' ka taatparya jeevan mein aatmiya sahare aur nishswarth prem ke kho jaane se hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which Indian state is the ancestral homeland of Kamala Das?
questions.explanation: Kamala Das ka paitrik ghar aur janmasthan Kerala rajya mein tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does 'frozen air' emphasize in the context of the grandmother's house?

options.B: Lifeless stillness, absence of warmth, and abandoned quietude

questions.explanation: Ghar band hone aur dadi ke na rehne se wahan ki hawa thandi, nishkriya aur sunsan ho chuki hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the line 'Behind my bedroom's door like a brooding dog', 'brooding' means ..........

options.B: Deeply thoughtful, mournful, and quietly watchful

questions.explanation: 'Brooding' ka arth chintan mein duba hua, shaant aur shok-magn hona hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of 'stranger' as used in 'strangers' doors'?
questions.explanation: 'Stranger' (ajanabi) ka vipritarthak shabd 'Acquaintance' ya parichit vyakti hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Only the Soul Knows How to Sing' was published in which year?
questions.explanation: Yeh sangrah saal 1996 mein prakashit hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the core message of Kamala Das's poem 'My Grandmother's House'?

options.A: Old village houses should be sold quickly
options.B: Childhood love from family is irreplaceable and deeply mourned when lost
options.C: Reading books is dangerous due to snakes
options.D: One should never live in a large house

questions.explanation: Kavita ka mool sandesh yahi hai ki bachpan mein dadi se mila nishkapat prem anmol hota hai jise khone ka dard aajiwan rehta hai.
